secrets_policy: This file lists variable NAMES and documented TYPES ONLY. No connection strings, passwords, API keys, signing private keys, real approval envelopes, access tokens or production secrets appear here or anywhere in the runtime source.

LIVE_AI_03B_TRUSTED_EXECUTOR_DB_URL.grant: EXECUTE on live_ai_03b_trusted.activate_catalog ONLY; no BUDGET-table DML; not superuser; not pg_write_all_data

LIVE_AI_03B_TRUSTED_READER_DB_URL.grant: read-only; SELECT on the fixed reviewed queries; no table DML; no EXECUTE of the activation function

LIVE_AI_03B_REVIEWER_TRUST_ROOT_DER_B64.note: reviewer PUBLIC key (SPKI DER, base64); never the private key

LIVE_AI_03B_CONNECTION_IDENTITY_PROOF_RE.note: reference to the independent connection->service identity proof source; NOT a DB name

owner_administrator.must_not: be inherited by the trusted executor or read adapter

independent_reviewer_signing_authority.authority: sole holder of the Ed25519 reviewer PRIVATE key; signs approvals out-of-band

trusted_activation_executor.authority: verify signed approval + invoke ONLY the restricted activation function

trusted_read_adapter.authority: read-only fixed reviewed queries; construct trusted observations
must_not_have: ability to authorize a second activation

trusted_executor_service.exposure: NO public HTTP endpoint, NO public TCP exposure; invoked only under explicit owner-controlled authority
trusted_executor_service.startup: MUST be inert — must not activate a catalog during normal build/import/install; no auto-run entrypoint
